Tolga Hoca’s strongest point is that he is, overall, a very good teacher. He teaches very clearly and at a reasonable pace. He cares about all of his students equally and makes sure that everyone is following along while understanding what is going on. He constantly asks the class if everyone/everything “is okay” and “understood” and if not you don’t have to feel shy or embarrassed about asking questions. It’s clear that he is very experienced in his profession and that all his students like him. He is always open to questions and also gives general life and career advice as well. He also sends review recordings before exams which is very helpful and generous. 

His only weak point in my opinion is that he keeps the air conditioning on no matter the weather outside. It could be sweltering hot or it could be snowing and without a doubt you’ll have to sit through two hours of class while potentially freezing (especially if you are a person who gets cold easily). I would recommend bringing an extra jacket to class even if it’s really hot out, and not sitting directly under the AC because otherwise you might wake up the next day with an headache or find out you’ve gotten sick two days later (just saying). 

Despite his love for a well-chilled environment, though, I would still highly recommend taking Man102 from Tolga Hoca as he is truly a very student-friendly and good teacher. I promise you won’t regret it :)

The course is fully based on Excel and Python and can be quite new and unfamiliar if you’ve never dealt with stuff like this before. It teaches you skills that are specific to business management (on Excel mainly) which are bound to come in useful in your career. 

The class goes on rotation with 4 hours of class one week and 2 hours the next week which is nice and the exams are not cumulative, which is also good. The exams are done in computer labs on computers which can be stressful but we are allowed to bring cheat sheets, which helps ease out our nerves, if not a tiny bit. 

The main thing that should be changed about this class in my opinion is that instead of our “Lab Activities” being 10% of our grade they could at least be 20 (Midterm 1 could also be 20% instead of 30 in this case, since the first midterm is a bit difficult to adjust to). Because the fact that we have around 20 lab activities and all of them in total affecting our overall grade just by 10% is a big disappointment after putting in so much effort into each task every week.
